summary: This directory centralizes the definition of core data structures, validation schemas, and TypeScript types used across the application to ensure data integrity, consistent formatting, and standardized communication between system components.
responsibilities: Define structural validation schemas for core business and system entities
Provide consistent TypeScript type definitions for validated data structures
Establish standardized data contracts for serialization and parsing
Enable runtime validation of complex data objects
relationships: Data schemas define the required shape of information, while TypeScript types provide static type safety for those same structures.
Centralized schema definitions facilitate consistent validation and serialization across different functional modules.
Structural models are composed of specific schema fragments to support complex entity representations.
designDecisions: Co-location of schema constants and their corresponding TypeScript types
Use of barrel files for centralized access to schema definitions
Schema-first approach to ensure runtime validation and static type safety
Modular decomposition of schemas based on domain entity types
